articles.headline: Ranked: Top 50 USMNT players for World Cup, based on club form
articles.description: Who are the 50 best Americans who should be selected for the World Cup roster? We look at club form and rank them as the USMNT Player Performance Index returns.

articles.headline: 43-year-old Gordon plus Curtis and Stewart named in Scotland's World Cup squad
articles.description: Scotland head coach Steve Clarke has named Craig Gordon, Findlay Curtis and Ross Stewart in his 26-man squad for the World Cup.

articles.headline: How PL title, relegation and Liverpool's CL place can be decided tonight

articles.headline: Carlo Ancelotti explains why João Pedro, Chelsea's Player of the Season, missed out on Brazil World Cup squad

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United linked with Dortmund duo
